SC-2025-S623.title: Georgetown County Building Requirements
SC-2025-S623.summary: AN ACT TO EXEMPT GEORGETOWN COUNTY FROM CERTAIN BUILDING REQUIREMENTS AND TO ALLOW THE COUNTY TO INSTEAD ENFORCE AE STANDARDS IN GEORGETOWN COUNTY'S FLOOD DAMAGE PREVENTION ORDINANCE. - RATIFIED TITLE

SC-2025-S1018.title: Palmetto Fellows Scholarship Program
SC-2025-S1018.summary: A BILL TO AMEND THE SOUTH CAROLINA CODE OF LAWS BY AMENDING SECTION 59-104-20, RELATING TO THE PALMETTO FELLOWS SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM, SO AS TO ADD THE CLASSIC LEARNING TEST AS AN APPROVED ASSESSMENT FOR RECEIVING SCHOLARSHIPS; BY AMENDING SECTION 59-149-50, RELATING TO THE LIFE SCHOLARSHIP, SO AS TO AMEND THE QUALIFICATIONS FOR A LIFE SCHOLARSHIP TO INCLUDE ACT AND CLT SCORES; AND BY AMENDING SECTION 59-26-20, RELATING TO THE DUTIES OF THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION AND COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION, SO AS TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "TALENTED AND QUALIFIED RESIDENT" TO INCLUDE ACT AND CLT SCORES.
SC-2025-S1018.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1018.aiSummary: The bill would change the rules for South Carolina scholarship programs. It would add the Classic Learning Test, or CLT, as an allowed test for the Palmetto Fellows Scholarship, and it would also let ACT and CLT scores count for the LIFE Scholarship and for a state education rule on qualified residents. The changes would affect students applying for these scholarships.

SC-2025-H5808.title: Cpt. Reed Koepp retirement
SC-2025-H5808.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO HONOR AND COMMEND CAPTAIN GREGORY R. "REED" KOEPP II, UNITED STATES NAVY, ON THE OCCASION OF HIS RETIREMENT AFTER TWENTY-SEVEN YEARS OF EXEMPLARY SERVICE, TO EXPRESS THE DEEPEST GRATITUDE OF A GRATEFUL STATE AND COMMUNITY FOR HIS OUTSTANDING LEADERSHIP AS COMMANDER OF JOINT BASE LINDSEY GRAHAM, FORMERLY JOINT BASE CHARLESTON, AND TO CELEBRATE HIS INSTRUMENTAL EFFORTS IN BRIDGING THE GAP BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND CIVILIAN COMMUNITIES IN THE SOUTH CAROLINA LOWCOUNTRY.
SC-2025-H5808.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5808.aiSummary: A House resolution would honor Captain Gregory R. "Reed" Koepp II of the U.S. Navy on his retirement after 27 years of service. It would also recognize his leadership at Joint Base Lindsey Graham, formerly Joint Base Charleston, and his work connecting the military and civilian communities in the South Carolina Lowcountry. The resolution was introduced and adopted.
